purpose: Cross-check low-speed calibration, explicitly flagged instrument/installation corrections, multiple stall weights, independently scoped turn/stall experiments, serial identity and source quality. No automatic solver parameter updates.

sources.aircraft: P-38H/J/L and F-5B family, not P-38G
sources.report: Pilot's Flight Operating Instructions for Army P-38H, P-38J, P-38L and F-5B; original restricted-era printing
sources.location: Original printed p.33, PDF p.37, airspeed/altimeter correction table; note expressly excludes field-test instrument errors; manual stalls on original printed p.7 already in US pack.

sources.report: AAF Eglin field flight assessment of Navy F6F-3, 26 Aug 1943, original memorandum
sources.location: Original pilot test text p.2–3; report section numbers differ between cover and subsequent sheets; 4 stall IAS-knot conditions, level speeds IAS-knot and approximate ROC.

sources.aircraft: P-38G and P-38F tactical comparative evaluation, specimen identities not established
sources.report: AAF Tactical Trials of P-38G, 3 May 1943
sources.location: Original wartime tactical comparative turn and stall speeds at 25,000 ft, maneuver flaps; weight and instantaneous G not recorded.

sources.report: A&AEE Report 692/m Part III: Position Error Correction Tests on Spitfire IX BF.274
sources.location: Original position-error tests measured 130–320 mph IAS; report also prints applied corrections at 109–127 mph, below measured anchor range.

sources.report: A&AEE original performance comparison of Spitfire IX BS354/BS543/BS551
sources.location: Original section 4 states BF.274 position-error correction permitted on BS.543: same make, position and setting of pressure head. 7485lb takeoff for BS543.

sources.aircraft: Spitfire VA Air Ministry W3119, NACA Langley
sources.report: NACA companion Measurements of the Flying Qualities of a Supermarine Spitfire VA, 1942
sources.location: Original airplane identity W3119, Merlin XLV, manufacturer nameplate output, pilot ASI error approx 10mph near minimum, original figure 7 correction; distinct from unrelated photographed R7347.

sources.report: NACA WR L-715 Part I, Longitudinal Stability and Control, February 1945
sources.location: Original Part I instrument calibration method, three CG/takeoff weight configurations; sister Part III stall report in existing pack.

sources.report: NACA RM L8A06 Flight Measurements of Flying Qualities of P-47D-30, 1948
sources.location: Printed p.6 steady-turn elevator-force lb/g, original figs.28–32; stall approach buffet margins, figs.56–59 are not sustained-turn curves.

sources.report: German Flugbericht on Fw 190 A-4 WNr 783, 1 Mar 1943
sources.location: Original dynamic-pressure pitot checked at three unspecified speeds and reported no position error: no numerically defensible near-stall CAS mapping.

sources.aircraft: Bf 109 G-2/Trop captured and evaluated in North Africa, serial unverified
sources.report: 209 Group wartime technical evaluation of Me 109 G-2 Trop; non-experimental establishment
sources.location: Contemporary reported clean/landing IAS and methodological caveat; mass and specimen identification not established.

sources.report: Secondary account of purported A&AEE original flight tests, unlocated original report
sources.location: Book-derived original test summary: 11,480lb, clean/landing IAS; conditional only until underlying A&AEE record is recovered.

sources.report: Original AAF Report on Frank I, Ki-84, captured T-2
sources.location: Original PDF p.8 airspeed calibration graphic and subsequent power/speed/climb charts; axis digitization not completed, no numerical extrapolation.
Original IAS corrections measured only at/above 120mph; 72/76mph IAS stalls in existing research pack. Motor power versus altitude correlation inconclusive.

series.source_location: Original printed p.33, calibrated* IAS versus airplane IAS, gear and flaps UP
series.conditions: Clean gear/flaps up; corrected* includes installation error ONLY; instrument errors from Field Test Set explicitly NOT included.
series.notes: The original uses the phrase Calibrated* IAS, BUT the footnote excludes instrument errors. Preserve as installation-corrected IAS*, NOT established CAS. Column calibrated_star_ias_mph is the source's wording.

series.source_location: Original printed p.33, gear and flaps DOWN
series.conditions: Gear/flaps down, calibration only at 89–140 mph cockpit IAS; lower landing stall IAS is BELOW calibration range.

series.source_location: Same handbook original p.7 clean stall table plus p.33 gear/flaps-up installation correction
series.conditions: Linearly interpolated WITHIN original cockpit IAS 83–106mph anchors; corrected* retains unmeasured instrument error; not calibrated CAS and not automatically activated in physics model.
series.notes: Original reported 1g IAS remains separately indexed in stall_us. Here *only* derived installation-corrected candidate is stored for future human-audited simulation transfer, never as fresh independent stall.

series.source_location: 26 Aug 1943 original F6F-3 test text, p.2–3
series.conditions: Reported IAS in KNOTS, not CAS; aircraft weight unspecified; specific on-power engine settings per row.

series.source_location: 26 Aug 1943 original F6F-3 test text, p.2–3
series.conditions: Reported IAS, not true speed; cooler settings differ and military power varies 0.5inHg between two 5500ft anchors: do NOT infer pure aerodynamic drag.
Approximately 3000fpm 'low altitude'; no exact altitude, calibrated speed or weight. Not a precision validation point.

series.aircraft: P-38G vs P-38F, Eglin 1943 tactical comparison
series.conditions: Maneuvering flaps; IAS at turn stall, not 1g clean stall and not sustained-turn rate; mass, exact G and test specimens unknown.

series.source_location: A&AEE/692m Part III, correction entries applied to flying condition tables
series.conditions: Reported PEC in mph to add to IAS. Original position-error measurement covered 130–320 IAS; entries BELOW 130 are original-applied extrapolation, not new measured calibration points.
series.notes: Original A&AEE LF IX BS543 explicitly borrows BF274 pressure-head position error based on identical head make/location/setting. This is an approved ORIGINAL cross-specimen transfer for relevant performance range, NOT a license to apply >130 mph tested correction to 70–100 mph stalls.

series.source_location: NACA 1942 companion flying-qualities report engine description
series.conditions: Nameplate horsepower ratings, NOT independently measured installed engine/propeller shaft power during stalls or turns.

series.source_location: NACA WR L-715 Part I loading/CG test configurations
series.conditions: Each is departure weight for Part I control testing, not instantaneous mass of Part III peak-CN stall; do not transfer without provenance.

series.source_location: NACA RM L8A06 printed p.6, figs.28–32
series.conditions: Approximate original published lb/g values in constant-speed constant-load steady turns; these are elevator stick FORCE GRADIENTS, NOT deg/s turn rate, maximum sustainable G, or turn drag.
rows: rear CG lower end of 2–7lb/g and possible reversal; approximate

series.conditions: Buffet occurs specified mph before reported stall at power/configuration; speed basis unspecified and no absolute stall IAS/CAS inferred.
Gross weight, engine-power and exact specimen unknown; original 209 Group assessment not an official experimental establishment; unsuitable for high-confidence fitted CLmax.

series.aircraft: Tempest V JN731, secondary A&AEE attribution
series.source_location: Book summary of claimed A&AEE trial, original PDF not yet located
series.conditions: 11480 lb source attributed trial weight; numbers IAS, not CAS; cross-check original report before promotion to full experimental evidence.

calibration_reviews.finding: 17 true original IAS versus 'Calibrated* IAS' handbook anchors. Footnote includes installation error only and explicitly excludes instrument error. Three within-range clean stall estimates reported as corrected*; landing 69–78mph lies BELOW lowest 89mph IAS landing anchor and is NOT corrected.
calibration_reviews.next: Find same-specific serial instrument field-test-set error and P-38D–G original T.O. 01-75F-1 before any CAS or G variant transfer.

calibration_reviews.finding: A&AEE explicitly used BF274 position error for BS543 based on matched pressure head. Original measured calibration range 130–320 IAS, applied corrections 109–127 are source extrapolations; no guaranteed sub-100mph stall correction.
calibration_reviews.next: Digitize measured original BF274 calibration and find independent near-stall Spitfire IX position-error data.

calibration_reviews.finding: NACA companion report W3119 says pilot cockpit ASI reads about 10 mph low near stall; stall report tabulates NACA IAS recorder which may differ. Do not apply a universal +10 mph to those ten original stall points.
calibration_reviews.next: Inspect Fig.7 instrumentation channel and source Figure 5 calibration correspondence to actual stall-table speeds.

calibration_reviews.finding: NACA calibration via trailing-bomb formation reference and high-speed flyby made service IAS nominally position-free; instrument and compressibility scale not fully confirmed for direct CAS. Parts I/III same BuNo and test family.
calibration_reviews.next: Trace service-meter instrument error and exact low-speed sample before marking NAS flight results full CAS.

calibration_reviews.finding: Original WNr783 test reports no position error at three unspecified check speeds; not evidence of low-speed zero PEC through stall, no numeric calibration points.
calibration_reviews.next: Find original explicit speed axes and exact pitot correction table for modeled Fw190A4.

calibration_reviews.finding: Captured Ki-84 T-2 original report has a calibration chart at PDF p8 plus level/climb performance curves; must separate measured original from estimates. No numerical chart anchors extracted yet.
calibration_reviews.next: Calibrate graphic axis and digitize with pixel uncertainty for the actual stall range; identify test weight/power.

calibration_reviews.finding: Original 10 IAS/corrected points already in global pack begin 120mph IAS, but two original stalls occur at 72–76mph. Stronger high-speed data does NOT justify sub-80mph CAS extrapolation.
calibration_reviews.next: Seek original low-speed PEC, unambiguous airframe/weight, engine-altitude charts; manufacturer power report could not be correlated in trial.

document_lineage.note: 17 correction anchors and 3 interpolated clean corrected* candidates do not add new measured stalls; P38H/J/L general manual NOT P38G.
A&AEE performance methodology explicitly borrows calibration based on unchanged pitot installation, only within valid measurement domain; two different aircraft, not independent calibrations.
W3119 is the documented original NACA 1941–42 test serial; previous R7347 photograph is not test identity proof.
Instrument method and takeoff loading supplement existing CN ranges for same BuNo; no independent stall replication.
New lb/g stick force and buffet margins do not constitute max sustained turn or new stall speed.
Same captured A6M3 original tests, no extra independent stalls; existing PEC high-speed only.
